what.text: This page follows refugees from the State of Palestine living in Algeria, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 157 Palestinian refugees in Algeria, 0.3% of all refugees from the State of Palestine.
Greece hosts the most Palestinian refugees in UNHCR's data, followed by Belgium, Iraq and Cyprus.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for the State of Palestine, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1976, 1988 to 1994 and 2000 to 2018.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1976 at 3200 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 5000, at the end of 1988, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Algeria.
These are year-end totals for Algeria only, reported to UNHCR.
